--- ## The 12 topics Column key: **answer** = the mark · **quote or fact** = the verbatim sentence, then context · **URL** · **date** = lastmod, retrieved. Rules as written on . A dash is unknown, not a fail. No topic gets its own letter. ### 1 · Housing that gets built
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date

The motion's encampment-harm clause is not scored on row 12. ## Working notes (internal, not for the cell) - **Sources read in full:** [electjeremy.ca](https://www.electjeremy.ca/) home and [/platform/](https://www.electjeremy.ca/platform/) (retrieved 2026-09-02; Future Focus / Achievements accordion body did not yield readable text — SiteGround challenge on raw HTML) · [ACTW profile](https://acitythatworks.ca/profiles/caradonna) · [City biography](https://www.victoria.ca/city-government/mayor-and-council/councillor-jeremy-caradonna) · [Victoria Buzz re-election 19 Dec 2025](https://victoriabuzz.com/2025/12/jeremy-caradonna-announces-plans-to-seek-re-election-as-victoria-city-councillor/) · [Victoria News re-election 21 Dec 2025](https://vicnews.com/2025/12/21/victoria-councillor-announces-re-election-bid-as-2026-municipal-gears-up/) · Times Colonist Missing Middle 27 Jan 2023, daytime sheltering 19 Jul 2024, budget trim 5 Mar 2026, budget adoption 9 May 2026, amalgamation 27 Jun 2026, spray-paint 22 May 2026 · [Storeys MM 27 Jan 2023](https://storeys.com/victoria-missing-middle-housing-initiative-passed-january-2023/) · [CHEK VicPD 4→2 3 Mar 2026](https://cheknews.ca/victoria-approves-2-not-4-officers-for-vicpd-slashes-reserve-contributions-1309089/) · [Victoria News budget 11 May 2026](https://vicnews.com/2026/05/11/group-consensus-victoria-approves-7-28-tax-hike-with-3-members-opposed/) · [CHEK graffiti 21 May 2026](https://cheknews.ca/victoria-moves-ahead-with-motion-to-look-at-472k-graffiti-problem-1325728/) · City budget page. Local notes at `/tmp/caradonna.md` were a 3/55 stub; every cell re-sourced against the live pages, not copied. - **Not a source, applied:** PhD / professor / Climate Action Secretariat / Rock Bay business; Fernwood farmstand; CRHC vice-chair; Transit Commission / Regional Water / theatres seats; Fairfield Gonzales liaison; third-party endorsements; 9,000 / 2,000 / 4,000 campaign totals (ASK, not ACTW); 31% GHG since 2007 (city-wide claim); Hermann's / Crystal Pool / bike-lane colour without a named vote this pass; LinkedIn OCP post (2025 Record, composition already clustered on row 1). - **One sentence, one measure — the ledger.** Five sentences carry the five scored cells: (1) named YES Missing Middle → row 1. (2) "could get behind the motion because it's just asking for the city to do more to enforce its own bylaws" → row 10. (3) named YES 7 May 2026 budget 9.34% residential → row 13. (4) graffiti NO / "I do agree that graffiti is a problem" → row 26. (5) named proposer of VicPD 4→2 → row 33. M81 is 📋, not a sixth scored cell. - **Matching 📋, shown, not in n:** amalgamation-question NO 25 Jun 2026 (row 55) — wanted binding, no 2026 Plan sentence. - **Do not invent roll-calls.** CSWB 3 Jul 2025, Crystal Pool, OCP, family-housing bylaw, and cooling-bylaw minutes were not given a named Caradonna yes/no in the press opened this pass beyond what is already used. Cooling is M9c struck anyway. - **Incumbent cap.** One sourced Program miss: M66 Opposed (YES on 9.34% residential). No sourced miss vs a 2026 Caradonna Plan sentence, because no readable 2026 Plan cells were invented. No Close cell this pass, so the Close-cap did not fire. - **Contested allocations.** Row 1 Partial not Close: Record-only MM YES, same treatment as Kim; family-housing policy is composition context, cluster = 1. Row 26 Weak 0.5 not Opposed: he agrees graffiti is a problem and votes against this staff-time instrument; ambiguity up. Row 33 Partial not Opposed: he proposed cutting new officers from four to two while saying VicPD is short and taxpayers are maxed. Row 55 📋 not Close: Hammond treatment of the same NO; FLAG if Joa reads the floor quote as 2026 words. - **Never-list:** no Lisnard / Estrosi / Knafo / Musk / Brivael / Poilievre language used as a source or analogy. - **M39 / M9c struck.** Not scored. M83 has no cell in this 55. Not scored. - **9,000.** Campaign approvals claim on the home page and in Dec 2025 launch coverage. Quoted as his. Not stamped as an ACTW number. - **Actions found that contradict a 2026 sentence:** none — there is no readable 2026 Plan sentence to contradict. M66 is a Record miss vs the Program. - **Rows to put to the candidate before publication:** row 1 (is there a 2026 unit target / composition share inside the unread accordion?) · row 13 (does YES on 9.34% still hold as his tax path?) · row 10 (is the 2024 daytime-sheltering YES still his 2026 position?) · row 33 (4→2 vs any funding-formula or regional-review position) · row 26 (does he have a cleanliness instrument other than opposing the spray-paint study?) · accordion (publish the Future Focus body in accessible text). - **Next mandatory re-check:** after nominations close **11 Sep 2026**, and immediately if the Future Focus accordion yields readable Plan text or a VoteMate questionnaire appears. - M83 (civic access / public correction, \$0) has no cell in this 55. Not scored. ## INTERNAL proposed letter — not the live letter **PROPOSE: D** · n = 5 · mean 0.50 Sum of scored marks: 1.0 + 1.0 + (−1.0) + 0.5 + 1.0 = **2.5** across **5** scored cells. Mean **0.50**, band **D** (0.50–0.99). D is already a live letter. **This is a proposal, not the live letter.** The card above shows **—**. The live letter waits for Joa's click and compute must not overwrite it. Alignment compute APPLIED for Caradonna stays **—**. **What the proposal is measuring.** Two Record hits (Missing Middle; daytime-sheltering YES), one Record miss (YES on 9.34% residential), one Weak (graffiti NO while agreeing it is a problem), one Partial (VicPD 4→2 phase-in). Fifty dashes are silence, not fails. The letter is D because the readable record is thin and the tax vote is Opposed, not because the unread accordion was invented as Plan. **Fragility.** Drop row 26 to a dash: n = 4, under 5, proposal becomes **—**. Recode row 33 to Opposed −1.0: mean 0.10 → F, which maps to **D** on the live set. Recode row 55 from 📋 to Close 2.0: n = 6, mean 0.75, still **D**. The letter moves only if Joa (a) drops graffiti and the 4→2 cell, or (b) reads Future Focus accordion text as Plan and adds cells.
